prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: revised full-fidelity desktop landing-page direction comp, 1440×900 landscape, edge to edge, no browser frame or device.
Primary request: official Colombian 3D-printing company “3DCreativeLab”; visitor understands it sells professionally printed objects and can explore the catalog.
Real visible content: “Hecho con precisión”, “Impresión 3D profesional para objetos disponibles y piezas bajo pedido.”, CTA “Explorar productos”, price sample “$ 89.000 COP”, status “Disponible”, links “Productos”, “Personalizados”, “Cómo fabricamos”, “WhatsApp”.
Composition: preserve the oversized human production-traveler sheet as the working storefront itself—message, finished 3D-printed object, price, stock and CTA arranged with the direct logic of a shop-floor job ticket, warm and commercial rather than bureaucratic. One large matte 3D-printed product is the central subject. The first viewport reveals the beginning of a featured-products section below with a different composition.
Visual law: only white, true black and vivid signal red. White is the dominant field, black carries type and structure, red owns the action, selected state and product. Bold utilitarian sans display plus highly readable body; stamped marks appear only for real availability. Materials feel like clean workshop stock, rubber ink and matte filament.
One dominant sheet; all interface remains legible and clickable.
Constraints: no cream, green, blue or additional colors; no gradients, no glass, no floating pill nav, no icon-card row, no fake reviews, discounts or statistics, no lorem ipsum, no browser chrome, no mockup device.
